name: MultiEURLEX: Multilingual Legal Document Classification
description: MultiEURLEX is a comprehensive multilingual legal dataset comprising 65,000 European Union legislative acts published in the Official Journal of the EU, translated into all 23 official EU languages (1.5 million document-language pairs total). Each document is annotated with EUROVOC concepts categorized into three granular levels of the EuroVoc taxonomy (level 1 with 21 labels, level 2 with 127 labels, and level 3 with 567 labels) to benchmark cross-lingual multi-label legal text classification.
